name: ChineseSafe
description: ChineseSafe is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating the safety capabilities of large language models in recognizing illegal and unsafe content in Chinese contexts, covering 4 classes and 10 sub-classes of safety issues aligned with Chinese internet content regulations.
reputation: A recent Chinese safety benchmark that is relevant for evaluating harmful-content recognition, but it is still emerging rather than universally adopted.
notes: Includes special types of illegal content such as political sensitivity, pornography, and variant/homophonic words; publicly available test set with 200,000 examples.
